subject: Problem displaying local image in shiny / leaflet popup

messages.author: 23c7e90875d0f700
messages.subject: Problem displaying local image in shiny / leaflet popup
parts:
Hello,

I don't understand why I'm not able to display a local image in leaflet marker popup.

The following line works well
addMarkers(data = POINT.value,lng=POINT.value$Longitude, lat=POINT.value$Lattitude, popup=paste0('<img src="http://www.lililamouette.com/wp-content/gallery/pingouins/thumbs/thumbs_pingouin-torda_-rabi_-2g.jpg"  height="42" width="42">'))

whereas the same replacing the imagename with a local file name doesn't work
 addMarkers(data = POINT.value,lng=POINT.value$Longitude, lat=POINT.value$Lattitude, popup=paste0('<img src="D://portail/photos/IMG_0691.jpg"  height="42" width="42">'))

I suppose my syntax for img src is not good.

Thank you very much for your hep,

Anthony
